columns.name: APP
columns.description: The application that updated the configuration, (e.g. IB for Intent Builder).

columns.name: CREATED_BY_ID
columns.description: Obsolete GUID of the user that created the revision.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record was added.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record was last modified.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PUBLISH_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the revision is published.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: REVISION
columns.description: This is the configuration revision for the record.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: ID of the user that created the revision.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
